# BalanceBikeToddler

## About
BalanceBikeToddler is a safety-focused kids mobility review and buying guidance site for balance bikes, kids bikes, scooters, strollers, and car seats.

## Pages
- [Home](https://balancebiketoddler.com/)
- [Products](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products)
- [Reviews](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews)
- [Guides](https://balancebiketoddler.com/guides)
- [News](https://balancebiketoddler.com/news)
- [About](https://balancebiketoddler.com/about)

## Product categories
Every category page lists the models it covers, with the specifications and the
safety notes for that class of ride.
- [Balance Bikes](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/balance-bikes/)
- [Kids Bikes](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/kids-bikes/)
- [Kids Scooters](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/kids-scooters/)
- [Kids Tricycles](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/kids-tricycles/)
- [Strollers](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/strollers/)
- [Electric Cars](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/electric-cars/)
- [Safety Seats](https://balancebiketoddler.com/products/safety-seats/)

## Comparisons
Side-by-side pages that put competing models against each other on the same
criteria, for a parent deciding between two options.
- [Balance Bike Top Picks](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/balance-bike-top-picks-compare)
- [Toddler Bike Parent Picks](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/toddler-bike-parent-picks-compare)
- [Kids Scooter Parent Picks](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/kids-scooter-parent-picks-compare)
- [Kids Tricycles Parent Picks](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/kids-tricycles-parent-compare)
- [Electric Cars for Parents](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/electric-cars-parent-compare)
- [Car Safety Seats for Parents](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/car-safety-seats-parent-compare)
- [Jogging Strollers for Parents](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare/jogging-stroller-parent-compare)
- [All Comparisons](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/compare)
- [Single Reviews](https://balancebiketoddler.com/reviews/single)

## News channels
The site keeps four channels of industry and product news, each written when
there is something to report rather than on a schedule.
- [Brand News](https://balancebiketoddler.com/news/brand_news)
- [Industry News](https://balancebiketoddler.com/news/industry)
- [New Products](https://balancebiketoddler.com/news/new_product)
- [Science](https://balancebiketoddler.com/news/science)

## Content focus
- Kids bike reviews and buying advice
- Balance bike safety and fit guidance
- Stroller and jogging stroller reviews
- Kids scooter recommendations
- Car seat and safety-seat guidance
- Transparency, testing method, and affiliate disclosure
